keyVerseDR: "...for with power he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him." (Mk 1:27)

level1.title: Jesus Has Power
level1.story: Jesus taught in the synagogue. A man with an evil spirit cried out. Jesus said, "Be quiet! Come out of him!" and the man was free.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did people say about Jesus?
When do you need Jesus' help?
level1.prayer: Jesus, protect me from evil. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus is stronger than evil
activity.intro: Number where your hand goes when you make the Sign of the Cross.
scenes: In the name of the Father (forehead)

level2.title: Teaching With Authority
level2.story: Jesus went into the synagogue in Capernaum on the sabbath and taught. The people were amazed, because He taught as one having authority. A man with an unclean spirit cried out, "I know who Thou art, the Holy One of God." Jesus said, "Speak no more, and go out of the man," and the spirit came out of him. Everyone asked, "What is this new teaching?" and His fame spread through all Galilee.
level2.keyLine: With power he commandeth even the unclean spirits: and they obey him.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How do we stay strong against temptation?
level2.prayer: St. Michael, defend us; Jesus, protect us. Amen.
